cards.label: RBA cash rate
cards.note: Raised 25 bp on 3 Nov, a 6–3 vote. Highest since Nov 2008; fifth rise of 2026.

cards.label: CPI inflation
cards.note: 12 months to Sep 2026 (ABS, 28 Oct). Trimmed mean 3.6%. Housing rose 5.2%.

cards.label: Unemployment
cards.note: Oct 2026 (ABS, 19 Nov), highest since Oct 2021. Youth rate 11.3%; underemployment 6.2%.

cards.label: Wage Price Index
cards.note: Year to Sep qtr (ABS, 18 Nov). Up 1.1% in the quarter, the strongest since Dec 2023.

cards.label: GDP growth
cards.note: Year to Jun qtr 2026 (ABS, 2 Sep), after +0.4% in the quarter. Next release 2 Dec.

cards.label: RBA inflation forecast
cards.note: CPI expected by Dec 2026, easing to 2.5% by Jun 2028 (RBA, Nov SMP).

cards.label: US federal funds rate
cards.note: Held on 28 Oct in a 10–2 vote; two members wanted a rise. Raised in September.

cards.label: US CPI inflation
cards.note: 12 months to Sep 2026; core 2.6%. October rose 0.4% on the month (BLS, 10 Nov).
